name: E [i:] Tokyo Kyonyuu Story
source:
Hero works at the counter of a coffee house along with five beautiful women. He lives on the second floor of the same building since it belongs to his father. One day he discovers a TV set that is connected to hidden cameras around the coffee shop...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-november-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角與五名美女一同在咖啡館的吧檯工作。店鋪所在的建築屬於父親，因此他就住在同一棟樓的二樓。一天，他發現了一臺電視，而它竟連接著暗藏在咖啡館各處的攝影機……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-november-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
